profile_text.body:
Hesai Group, which does business as Hesai Technology, describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and a manufacturer of lidar sensors. According to its website, its lidar products serve ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and the company says lidar acts as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, enabling features such as automated emergency braking (AEB) and navigation on autopilot (NOA). It also says it supplies sensors that meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The company states that it partners with automotive OEMs and autonomous vehicle and robotics companies worldwide and that it has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. Its stated focus areas are ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence.

Hesai Group is a public company headquartered in Shanghai and trades under the ticker HSAI. Its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001861737. No litigation is recorded against it.
